description: Creates comments on the specified Work Item or resource using the request body and returns the created comment resources. The target must be writable by the signed-in user. Use `getComments` to list comments and `postDocumentComments` or `postPageComments` for comments on those specific resource families. Effect: creates a new resource. Repeating this call may create additional resources; it is not guaranteed idempotent. Tip: set `dry_run: true` first to validate the arguments and preview the exact request without sending it to Polarion. The executor returns this preview as normal text, and as structured content when the tool declares an output schema.

dry_run.description: If true, validates the request and returns the exact request that would be sent to Polarion — with the Authorization header redacted and any binary payload summarized by byte length — without actually sending it.

projectId.description: The Polarion project ID (its URL segment, e.g. `myproject`), case-sensitive. Required to scope the request to one project. If the ID is unknown, ask the user; getProjects lists IDs only with global read access.

workItemId.description: The Work Item's ID within its project (e.g. `WI-123`), not the combined `project/id` path used in some link payloads.

name: postComments
